label: letter t at a late original position (4+) in sequences that start with n
explanation: Sparse conjunction feature. It fires almost only in sequences whose first original token is n (97.5% of activation mass) and only late in the original phase (orig_idx 4-7, peaking at 5-6). It never fires at t<4 or in the copy phase after the delimiter, and gives a small amount on <DEL> (6% of mass). Within that context the input token is mostly t (78% of mass, 22x lift), and the largest activations are all n ... t. Precision is low: most n-initial sequences with a late t do not activate it (about 17% precision on dev). Activations look stronger when the prefix contains q/r/o/d/p, for example prev_tok q (61% precision), but adding a seen-set condition only lifts F1 to about 0.37. Missed activations are weak firings on other tokens (e, v, q, 3, <DEL>) at the same positions in n-initial sequences.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=n (+5.97), prev_tok=q (+2.84), orig2=d (+2.38), orig2=o (+1.97), phase=0 & in_tok=t (+1.76), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=t (+1.76). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-2.77), phase=2 (-2.17), t=3 (-1.73), prev3_tok=n (-1.53).
